title: Correction
description: Operator-authored correction envelope. Each correction targets a single entity (commentary insight, search projection field, etc.), captures the original snapshot for auditability, and records the operator-supplied payload that produced the change. Corrections are append-only — applying or rejecting a correction does not mutate the original envelope; it transitions `status` and stamps `applied_at`. See ADR-0011 (contract conventions) and the HITL Foundation milestone (issue #420).

correction_id.description: Stable correction identifier issued by platform-control.

target_entity_type.description: Family of the entity this correction acts on. Determines how `target_entity_id` is parsed and how `payload` is interpreted by the apply handler.

target_entity_id.description: ID of the targeted entity. Format depends on `target_entity_type` (e.g. `ins_*` for commentary_insight, `doc_*` for document). Validated by the platform-control apply handler against the family prefix.

correction_type.description: Kind of correction action. Drives the apply pipeline: `field_edit` writes an overlay, `annotation` attaches operator notes, `reject` removes the entity from downstream surfaces, `rescore_request` enqueues a re-extraction or re-projection job.

payload.description: Correction-type-specific body. Shape MUST match `correction_type`: for `field_edit` an object of `{field_path: new_value}`; for `annotation` `{label, text, anchor?}`; for `reject` `{reason_code}`; for `rescore_request` `{requested_pipeline, parameters?}`. Validators in platform-control enforce per-type shape; this schema keeps it open so the envelope can evolve without breaking existing rows.

original_snapshot.description: Frozen pre-correction state of the targeted fields. Required for `field_edit` and `reject`; optional for `annotation` and `rescore_request`. Used for diff display and revert. Stored verbatim; not transformed by the apply handler.

operator_id.description: Identity of the operator submitting the correction. Opaque string sourced from the auth token (subject claim).

pipeline_run_id.description: When the correction was prompted by a specific document-intelligence run (e.g. operator caught an extraction error in the run review queue), the originating run id is recorded here. Null for corrections raised from ad-hoc detail-page review.

rationale.description: Free-text operator justification. Surfaced in the correction history view and exported in audit logs.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `pending` is the freshly-submitted state awaiting an apply pass; `applied` means the overlay/job was successfully written; `rejected` means an operator or guardrail vetoed it; `superseded` means a newer correction on the same target replaced this one.

created_at.description: Timestamp the correction envelope was persisted.

applied_at.description: Timestamp the correction transitioned to `applied`. Null while pending/rejected/superseded.
